firefly-connection-entry-description: Sync with your own Firefly III server
firefly-connection-token-help: Create a token in Firefly III under Options > Profile > OAuth. It is stored in secure storage and never shown again.
firefly-connection-token-session-only: No secure storage is available. The token is kept for this session only.
firefly-connection-url-invalid: This is not a valid server URL
firefly-connection-url-https: The server URL must use https://
firefly-connection-error-network: The server could not be reached
firefly-connection-error-not-found: No Firefly III API was found at this URL
firefly-connection-error-unavailable: Connecting is not available in this build
firefly-connection-mode-description: Use the server as the source of your data
firefly-connection-sign-out-description: Deletes the token from this device. Your local data is kept.
firefly-connection-replace-title: Replace local data with server data?
firefly-connection-replace-description: A backup of your current data is saved first. Then all local transactions, accounts, categories and budgets are removed and replaced with the data on your Firefly III server. Your settings are kept.
firefly-connection-replace-failed: The backup could not be written. Nothing was changed.
firefly-connection-full-resync-descripti: Download every transaction again and reconcile
firefly-connection-apply-rules: Apply server rules to new transactions
firefly-sync-status-parity-mismatch: {count} account balances differ from the server
firefly-sync-identity-changed: This device was synced with a different Firefly III server or account. Reset local Firefly data (replace local data with server data) before syncing with this server or account.
firefly-sync-auth-required: The server rejected the token. Enter a new personal access token.
firefly-sync-failed: Sync failed. It will be retried on the next sync.
firefly-conflicts-description: The server version was kept. You can re-apply your local version, which is uploaded on the next sync.
firefly-conflicts-reapply-unsupported: This kind of record cannot be re-applied
firefly-onboarding-connect-description: Use your self-hosted Firefly III server
firefly-connection-meta-roaming: Sync colours, icons and order across devices
firefly-connection-meta-roaming-descript: Stores Cashew-only display settings as Firefly III preferences
